conn.intro: Atlas reads your OKX account with these keys. They’re encrypted on this Mac and never shown again.
conn.sealLabel: Seal of the OKX demo account ending {{last4}}
conn.untested: Keys saved. They haven’t been tested yet.
conn.failedLineAgo: The last test failed. Last verified {{ago}}.
conn.cantTest: Atlas couldn’t run the test. Last verified {{ago}}.
conn.footnote: Atlas never withdraws or moves money, and refuses live keys that can withdraw.
conn.accountNote: OKX reports these details each time Atlas tests the connection.

none.title: Not connected
none.body: Connect the OKX demo account so Atlas can read its balances, positions and history.

loadError.title: Couldn’t load your connections
loadError.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.

lv.title: Live account
lv.noneBody: Add a key from your OKX live account with Read and Trade only. Adding it doesn’t switch Atlas to live; that happens in Settings → Environment, after the pre-flight.
lv.notVerified: Not verified. This key can withdraw funds.
lv.failedLine: Not verified. The last test failed.
lv.cantTest: Not verified. Atlas couldn’t run the test.
lv.untested: Not verified. The key hasn’t been tested yet.

withdraw.title: This key can withdraw funds
withdraw.body: Create a key with Read + Trade only, then replace it here. Atlas never moves money, and it won’t trade live with a key that could.

lv.envTitle: Switch Atlas to live in Settings → Environment
lv.envSub: Adding this key didn’t switch anything. The pre-flight there decides when you can.
lv.envLiveTitle: Atlas is trading on this account
lv.envLiveSub: Switch back to demo in Settings → Environment.
lv.footnote: Atlas refuses a live key that can withdraw, and never moves money.
lv.sealLabel: Seal of the OKX live account ending {{last4}}

ck.title: Connect the OKX live account
ck.text: Create the key on your OKX live account with Read and Trade only. Atlas refuses a key that can withdraw.

rk.title: Replace the OKX live keys
rk.text: Paste a new key from the OKX live account, with Read and Trade only. Atlas tests it before it replaces the current one.

lv.okToastBody: OKX live answered at {{time}}. Withdrawals are off.
lv.refusedToastBody: It can withdraw funds. Create one with Read + Trade only.
lv.savedToastBody: API key •••• {{last4}}. Environment’s first check passes now.

rm.title: Remove the OKX live connection?
rm.text: Atlas deletes the live keys from this Mac, and Environment’s first check fails until you add a key again. Your OKX account and its funds are not touched.
rm.blocked: Atlas is trading on this account. Switch to demo in Settings → Environment before you remove it.
rm.toastBody: The live keys were deleted from this Mac.

rk.title: Replace the OKX demo keys
rk.text: Paste a new key from the OKX demo account. Atlas saves it and tests it straight away.

ck.title: Connect the OKX demo account
ck.text: Paste the key you created in OKX demo trading. Atlas saves it and tests it straight away.

rm.title: Remove the OKX demo connection?
rm.text: Atlas stops syncing this account, and the Portfolio pages stop updating. The keys are deleted from this Mac. Your OKX account and its funds are not touched.
rm.toastBody: The keys were deleted from this Mac.
rm.failed: Atlas couldn’t remove the connection. Try again.

risk.intro: The limits the risk engine applies to every trade.
risk.limitsNote: Percentages are of total equity. The risk engine applies these limits to every trade, and no agent can change them.
risk.activityNote: Every save is a new version, sent to the risk engine and the agents straight away.
risk.savedBody: The risk engine uses the new limits from its next check.

saveError.title: Couldn’t save your settings
saveError.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running, then try again.

risk.invalid: Fix the highlighted limits, then save again.

conflict.title: Settings changed elsewhere — reloaded
conflict.body: Version {{v}} was saved in another window while this page was open. These are its values.

error.title: Couldn’t load your settings
error.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.

err.range: {{label}} must be more than {{min}} and at most {{max}}.
err.other: Atlas’s server didn’t accept this value for {{label}}.

help.lossPerTrade: The most one trade can lose if its stop is hit, as a share of equity.
help.positionSize: The largest single position, as a share of equity.
help.dailyLoss: Trading pauses for the day when losses reach this share of equity.
help.weeklyLoss: Trading pauses for the week when losses reach this share of equity.
help.leverage: No position uses more leverage than this, whatever OKX allows.
help.openPositions: New trades wait while this many positions are open.
help.instrumentShare: The most equity that can sit in one instrument across positions.
help.correlated: The most equity in instruments that move together (30-day correlation above 0.8).
help.minR: A trade must aim to win at least this many times what it risks.
help.lossStreak: Trading pauses after this many losing trades in a row.

scope.label: Settings for
scope.editLive: You’re editing the live settings. They apply once Atlas switches to live in Settings → Environment.
scope.editDemo: You’re editing the demo settings. Atlas is trading on live.
